decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - No work shall start on site without prior written notification of the start to the London Division of the Historic Buildings and Monuments Commission, quoting reference date _________.

Condition : 4 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by that Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The CCTV camera system hereby approved shall comprise of D150HF-CHQE3V6 dome cameras or other dome cameras submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 6 - No works shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the repair of the walls and floor of Hounslow West Underground Station have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details submitted, a revised detail for Signs 16 and 18 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before they are installed and the sign shall be installed as so approved.
description: Refurbishment (both internal and external of Osterley Underground Station including installation of cameras, speakers and visual display units and retiling the booking hall.
